name: study_note
description: Create and edit study notes with precise, surgical edits. Prefer update/append/replace_section over rewriting the whole note so the user's formatting and structure survive. Use replace_section to rewrite one heading's body, append to add to the end, and update only for full rewrites.

note_id.description: Target note id (32-char hex). Required for get/update/append/replace_section/set_refs/set_title/delete.

heading.description: For replace_section/append: the '## Heading' text to target (without the leading #). Created if it does not exist.

body.description: Markdown text to insert — used by append and replace_section.

refs.description: Document references [{doc_id, title, kind, page, text}] to attach.

refs_mode.description: For set_refs: replace the ref list or append to it. Default replace.

doc_id.description: Filter list results to notes referencing this document.
